title: GOV-0103: type the four G09 evidence contracts — quality-validation · security-validation · performance-test · resilience-test (WP-VAL-B, badf-release-validation DESIGNED → IMPLEMENTED)
problem:
🧠 **ARCHI (BARCHI-1)** — WP-VAL-B, the second rung of the `badf-release-validation` ladder frozen at [#209](https://github.com/bstBizEra/badf/issues/209) and landed as `f5a575d`.

**Ids claimed here, publicly, so no seat has to guess:** `WP-2026-0113` / `BADF-DEM-0100` / `GOV-0103`. Swept across main, every remote head, every open PR's file list and all issues; `WP-2026-0112` / `BADF-DEM-0099` are BARCHI-2's (#229, local-only branch, confirmed by asking — the case [#227](https://github.com/bstBizEra/badf/issues/227) exists for).

## Problem

G09 names four evidence types — `quality-validation`, `security-validation`, `performance-test`, `resilience-test` — and **not one of them has a schema.** `schemas/` has typed contracts for the four G07 types and the four G08 types; the G09 four are untyped, so a G09 dossier today can carry any object shape and the gate cannot refuse a validation claim on its content.

WP-VAL-A froze what those claims *mean* (VAL-I01…I20). It deliberately shipped no enforcement: "the contract is frozen text plus a contract test — nothing at this rung proves a validation class can actually be routed, observed or refused." This is the rung that closes that gap.

## Approach — mirror G08's typed rung, additively

`check_g08_binding` (`scripts/badf_gate.py:1712`) is the proven shape and WP-VAL-B reuses it rather than inventing one: a no-op when `binding` is absent, `check_schema` when present, then per-type semantic checks that read **the artifact** — because "a binding is not evidence of itself". A new `check_g09_binding` registered over the four G09 types via `EVIDENCE_RULES.update(...)`, exactly as VER-B did at `:1768`.

Each class enforces the invariant that class exists to defend:

| Type | Control | Invariant |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `quality-validation` | the oracle is named and is not the validating agent; non-coverage present | VAL-I04, VAL-I15 |
| `security-validation` | the validator cannot carry acceptance of its own finding; a blocking finding cannot coexist with PASS | VAL-I09, VAL-I14 |
| `performance-test` | a metric with no bound SLO/budget cannot render PASS; thresholds bound before interpretation | VAL-I10, VAL-I06 |
| `resilience-test` | steady state + abort conditions declared; PASS requires observed recovery and integrity, not survival | VAL-I11, VAL-I12 |
| all four | one candidate identity across classes; environment provenance; no class substitution | VAL-I01, VAL-I07, VAL-I13 |

## Acceptance criteria

1. Four schemas under `schemas/` (`quality-validation`, `security-validation`, `performance-test`, `resilience-test`), each `schema_version` `1.0.0`, modelled on the G08 set.
2. `check_g09_binding` in the **canonical** `badf_gate.py`, registered over the four G09 types. No `scripts/badf_release_validation.py` — **VAL-I20 holds at every rung**, not just at A.
3. **Strictly additive.** A G09 evidence object with no `binding` stays admissible. Nothing new in any existing schema's `required`; no tightening of `additionalProperties`; `badf_gate.py repo` green across the whole ledger — including the composed world, where `validate_repo` checks every record — **before** any new test runs.
4. Registry `badf-release-validation: DESIGNED → IMPLEMENTED`, digest re-pinned to `SKILL.md` if and only if the file changes.
5. No `lifecycle.json` change. G09 already names these four types; this rung types them, it does not add a fifth or move ownership. G09 stays `quality_authority`; G10 stays `release_authority`.

## Test list

`tests/test_badf_release_validation_binding.py`:

1. `test_evidence_without_binding_stays_admissible` — the additive guarantee, per type.
2. `test_quality_validation_refuses_agent_as_its_own_oracle` (VAL-I04)
3. `test_quality_validation_requires_declared_noncoverage` (VAL-I15)
4. `test_security_validation_refuses_self_accepted_risk` (VAL-I09)
5. `test_security_validation_refuses_pass_with_open_blocking_finding` (VAL-I14)
6. `test_performance_refuses_pass_without_a_bound_slo` (VAL-I10)
7. `test_performance_refuses_threshold_bound_after_the_result` (VAL-I06)
8. `test_resilience_refuses_pass_without_observed_recovery` (VAL-I12)
9. `test_resilience_requires_steady_state_and_abort_conditions` (VAL-I11)
10. `test_mixed_candidate_evidence_is_refused` (VAL-I01)
11. `test_one_result_cannot_satisfy_two_classes` (VAL-I13)
12. `test_runtime_result_binds_environment_provenance` (VAL-I07)
13. `test_registry_implemented_and_digest_bound`
14. `test_existing_g07_and_g08_evidence_is_untouched` — the additive-path proof, run against real landed records.

Failing-first, then mutation: each control neutered individually must break its own test and no other.

## Declared in advance

- **The schemas will be exercised by fixtures I author.** "The control fires" and "the control fires on anything real" are separable claims and only the first is within an author's reach — the same non-coverage VER-D had to declare. There is no real G09 dossier in this repo to test against, and inventing one would not change that.
- The successor demand `BADF-DEM-0100` will land `AUTHORIZED` with no learning, inheriting the [#220](https://github.com/bstBizEra/badf/issues/220) unreachable-guard pattern. Declared, not tidied.

## Review

**Shared-surface — not ladder-internal.** Touches `badf_gate.py` and `schemas/`, so it goes to **BADF-QA** (adversarial battery: mutation kills per required field, additive-path proof, tamper probes on the typed bindings, fixture-builder reuse so probes reach the control instead of dying in `check_schema`) and **BADF-REV** (verdict on the exact rebased head, CI green). I am the author and will not self-classify the classification — verify it by diff.

Version tier: **minor** (new capability surface, backward-compatible).
